A coherent original European indie comic-book art direction, hand-inked contours, flat gouache shading, controlled paper grain, slightly grotesque bar patrons depicted ONLY inside character cards. This must look like a physical CARD GAME IN A FILTHY ITALIAN DIVE BAR, not a website/dashboard and not a combat arena with full-sized people.

Scene: overhead with slight perspective, a broad scratched dark walnut tabletop occupies almost the whole screen, rounded table edge visible at bottom. Sticky brown glass rings, a small spilled drink at the edge, cigarette burns, chipped dark green glass ashtray with two cigarette ends at far left edge, battered burgundy vinyl booth in the distant top corners. Grime is localized and intentional; readable areas are clean. Rich warm walnut, tobacco brown, dusty bottle green, oxblood burgundy, muted petrol blue and worn ivory card stock. Every usable object is an illustrated rectangular playing CARD placed flat next to its owner; bottles or drinks NOT loose playable 3D objects. Beside it on a small battered circular paper coaster: "BICE" and a large heart icon with "68". Tiny readable resource line "A 35 · V 0 · T 10 · L 0". Exactly THREE smaller face-UP OBJECT CARDS directly to the right of Bice's character, separated and countable, titles: "Tennents Super", "Negroni Trovato per Terra", "Mescolone Micidiale". Each marked "OGGETTO" and illustrated respectively as a green beer bottle, short red cocktail glass, strange tall mixed drink. Keep these cards large enough to see their rectangular paper edge and illustration.

Exactly ONE own OBJECT CARD beside it: "Peroni da 66, calda", marked "OGGETTO", illustrated plain brown beer bottle (no commercial logo).

1 "ADOPERIAMOTI", secondary "BASE", cost "—", "P −1", grasping hand illustration, small loop mark for persistence.

6 "GARGANTUESCO IMPATTO SUL TU", secondary "AZIONE", "25 V", "P 0", huge comic fist illustration.
Use neatly hand-lettered condensed caps for card names and extremely legible numerals. Illustration dominates the card face. No invented damage/stat numbers. No explanatory text on the uninspected cards.
Minimal HUD: top left small faded print "BOTTE MICIDIALI"; top right a small enamel clock "24 s" and small ellipsis menu; bottom right a modest worn ivory pill "Riordina". Near bottom center over wood tiny text "Scegli una carta". No prominent header/footer bars. Health readable numerically, no max-health fraction or capped gauge.
Do not include any normative references, R01/Rxx, JSON, debug text, laboratory labels, mockup label, developer annotation, explanatory callouts, rules citations, extra hands, extra players, extra cards, response stack, mana gems or board lanes. No human hands holding the cards. Elegant readable spacing, crafted game key-art quality but believable usable UI.

From left: "ADOPERIAMOTI" (BASE, —, P −1, grasping hand, loop icon);
"SVEGLIAMOCI MA TU NO" (LEGATA, —, P 1, cheek slap, loop icon);
